purpose: Drive the public controller CLI over immutable iteration_003 source/data in place, retain two complete clean causal traversals, retain typed compact fault evidence for all 20 normalized and iteration-003 causal cases, prove the historical-HEAD repair against its exact predecessor, and emit an independently reopenable exact retained-file inventory.

simulator_surface.controller_invocation: subprocess public simulate and reopen CLI only
simulator_surface.simulator_only_evidence_root: PW_R9_SIMULATOR_EVIDENCE_ROOT names an existing absolute regular nonlink directory; controller run roots remain absent direct children

compact_root.caller_root_rule: Caller supplies one absent safe direct-child suite root; reuse is forbidden.
compact_root.source_strategy: Normal traversals read the controller, backend, verifier, contracts, manifests, and transitive semantic files from immutable iteration_003/SUCCESSOR locations in place and bind them once by path, SHA-256, bytes, Git blob OID, HEAD blob OID, local HEAD, and local origin/main. The R9-REG-020 causal variant alone creates two minimal local Git source-closure sandboxes, advances only one unbound marker, reopens recorded blobs, and exact-unlinks both sandboxes with no network.
compact_root.clean_evidence: evidence/synthetic-clean-001 and evidence/synthetic-clean-002 retain every provider_input.txt, attempt.json, raw_result.json, completion.json, 54 route-local artifacts, three path terminals, matrix terminal, accounting, and run manifest.
compact_root.fault_evidence: fault_evidence retains only compact controller roots needed for direct lifecycle or path-stop observation; faults retains one canonical typed receipt per normalized variant/global case and exact before/after capture bytes for mutation cases.
compact_root.working_roots: work/tmp-* is never final evidence. It may be removed only by exact regular-file unlink and directory rmdir after typed captures are durable. No gio, trash, recursive remove, symlink, or broad deletion is permitted.
compact_root.final_evidence: Never deleted or compacted after simulator_receipt.json is created.

source_bundle.validation: Every semantic_manifest files row is a safe regular nonlink with exact declared SHA-256 and bytes. Top-level iteration controls and the operating contract are also bound.
source_bundle.git: Record exact current Git blob OID and HEAD blob OID for every bound file plus local HEAD, local origin/main, scoped porcelain-v2 bytes, and equality booleans. No fetch or network occurs.
source_bundle.custody_rule: A suite can test exact current binding while stabilization exit remains FAIL until every bound byte matches a pushed local HEAD equal to fetched origin/main and external review closes.

causal_requirements.stage_storage: canonical exact expected_artifact plus one LF
causal_requirements.post_fail: The first valid FAIL in a route stops that route before any later attempt; other routes may start their own first row, so uniform synthetic FAIL yields exactly three row chains and zero later same-slot starts.
causal_requirements.controller_invalid: Abort every route with no later attempt or artifact.
causal_requirements.reopen: Controller public reopen invokes the independent verifier, which replays cell gates, stage eligibility, artifact exactness, terminals, bundle binding, freshness, deterministic score, and accounting.

regression_coverage.mapping: Every catalog regression_id and stabilized scenario_id appears exactly once; all variants become terminal before the coverage meta-case passes.
regression_coverage.predecessor_rule: Every predecessor receipt is reopened against catalog SHA-256 and bytes and remains typed FAIL.
regression_coverage.current_rule: PASS means only the current zero-provider simulator observed the required behavior or rejection; it never reclassifies predecessor evidence.

historical_head_reproducer.predecessor: iteration_002 public reopen returns CONTROLLER_INVALID with offline verifier RUN_GIT_HEAD_DRIFT after only current HEAD advances
historical_head_reproducer.successor: iteration_003 public reopen returns the unchanged valid subject-failure terminal with typed historical_head_reopen PASS after the same HEAD-only advance

required_faults: ordered stop at a row boundary

retained_inventory.write_order: last after simulator_receipt.json and after work is empty and removed
retained_inventory.coverage: Every retained regular file is listed by relative path, SHA-256, and bytes. inventory.json is the sole explicit cryptographic self-reference exclusion.
retained_inventory.independent_reopen: The simulator immediately reopens the canonical inventory, compares the exact retained path set and every identity, and reopen-suite repeats the check plus controller public reopen for each retained clean run.

suite_receipt.write: create-only canonical JSON plus one LF after all requested work is terminal and before inventory.json

fail_closed: A missing or nonregular controller.py, backend.py, verifier.py, contract, manifest, or semantic source blocks execution.
Any source-bundle change during a clean traversal or suite fails the suite.
Any controller invocation outside public simulate or reopen is impossible in simulator code and fails static inspection.
Any malformed or noncanonical durable controller JSON fails the scenario.
Any clean run other than exactly 291 PASS chains, 54 artifacts, three path terminals, matrix terminal, and accounting fails.
Any post-FAIL later same-slot start fails.
Any missing normalized family, variant, required fault label, causal global case, or predecessor identity fails.
Any retained symlink, nonregular member, pycache, bytecode, un-inventoried file, inventory mismatch, retry, replacement, best-of, or duplicate clean identity fails.
An incomplete suite never writes a PASS receipt.

stabilization_exit.rule: The simulator always reports stabilization exit FAIL/NOT_AUTHORIZED and names remaining pushed-Git custody and independent-review blockers. Suite PASS is subordinate zero-credit evidence only.

nonclaims: Synthetic runs earn zero empirical or qualification credit.
A suite PASS is not stabilization exit, preseal audit, formal candidate, freeze, canary, matrix qualification, production readiness, or release authority.
Static source-binding projections do not claim hostile-code execution or malicious-controller resistance.
The simulator does not claim resistance to a malicious trusted controller, host compromise, arbitrary private callers, callbacks, reflection, or missing capability tokens.
